# Prop naming registry

<!-- Generated from skills/_shared/prop-naming.json by scripts/prop-naming.mjs. Do not edit. -->

## How to use

- Look up both meaning and name before proposing a prop; review semantic meaning with a human.
- Reuse a matching responsibility and append its component usage; propose a new semantic ID for a new responsibility.
- Existing usage is evidence, never automatic global approval. Conventions start as proposed and require separate scoped approval.
- Aliases are search references, not accepted extra API props. Exceptions record component scope, alternative propName and reason; null approval means pending, never API permission.
- Native attributes are not proprietary conventions unless an explicit semantic policy is proposed.
- Types belong to each component: no universal type requirement or forced API migration.
- Validation checks schema, case-folded collisions, repository containment, approval structure/content hashes and evidence file hashes. It cannot prove meaning, human consent, symbol existence or actual TypeScript types; no parser or network lookup is used.
- Update the JSON, then run `pnpm props:docs` and `pnpm props:check`; `--check` (default) never writes. `--write` regenerates only this view, never approval or evidence hashes.

## Approval and reviewed-source evidence

- A proposed convention has `approval: null`. Approved/deprecated conventions require `{reference, scope, contentHash}`; the exact scope is `convention:<entry.id>` (case-sensitive). Status changes require a new matching approval.
- A recoverable reference is an HTTPS resource URL (path or fragment, no embedded credentials), or an existing repository-relative file with an optional non-empty #locator. Structure/local existence is checked, not external accessibility or authenticity. A human must recover and inspect the actual scoped decision; never invent approval.
- An exception is `{scope, propName, reason, approval}`: scope is one alphanumeric component name starting with a letter, not a wildcard; propName is the alternative public name, not a global alias. Approved exceptions require approval scope `exception:<entry.id>:<scope>:<propName>`. Pending exceptions grant no permission; approved alternatives must not collide with another recorded public name in that component.
- `conventionHash(entry)` and `exceptionHash(exception)`, exported by scripts/prop-naming.mjs, return `sha256:<64 lowercase hex digits>`. Canonicalization uses compact JSON, recursively sorted object keys (JavaScript string order), UTF-8 and no final newline; strings are unchanged. Aliases and exception payloads are sorted as semantic sets; other array order is preserved.
- The convention payload is exactly `{id, name, meaning, whenToUse, avoid, status, aliases, exceptions}`, with exceptions reduced to `{scope, propName, reason}`. It excludes all approvals and usage observations: appending a component usage or recording an exception approval cannot change global approval content. Exception hashes cover exactly `{scope, propName, reason}`, excluding their own approval. Changed semantic content requires fresh scoped approval, not merely a recalculated digest.
- Each usage source is `{path, symbol, revision}`: a repository-confined actual file, the manually inspected public API symbol (for example TabsProps or GaugeProps), and `sha256:<whole-file byte hash>` of the reviewed working-tree file. These are content revisions, not invented Git commits. Initial evidence was manually read, including Gauge draft v0.6; numeric `GaugeSize | number` CSS-pixel ability is confirmed, not overall API approval.
- Source freshness is intentionally conservative: even an unrelated edit anywhere in that file invalidates its evidence. Re-read the source and explicitly update JSON after human API review; matching bytes alone do not establish name/type correctness or review quality.

| description / content-description | Optional visible short plain text that explains the content or purpose of its element, rendered next to its title | Use: Provide a short explanatory text alongside the title of a content unit or dialog.<br>Avoid: Accessible name or heading (use title), form help (use hint), editorial section introductions (use lede), status notes (use statusText), rich or interactive content. | approved; Reference: docs/decisions/prop-naming-content-description-approval.json; scope: convention:content-description; contentHash: sha256:92f47129d24cb259734c592d154382c9d9c836f0da8150ef784889b186b0bb4f | AlertDialogContent: string (required) (existing); path: packages/ui/src/molecules/alert-dialog/types.ts; symbol: AlertDialogContentProps; revision: sha256:5f4908ab3c919e382f244ec2b22759376d2cd6ebb842010e8d2e9c7da3fb1c8b<br>ArticleFeature: string (existing); path: packages/ui/src/molecules/article-feature/types.ts; symbol: ArticleFeatureProps; revision: sha256:7adcf6ea1db188214aaa20f1e8c9a8706ac7a7d206d5d306ac4b5bf8d71294ac<br>DialogContent: string (existing); path: packages/ui/src/molecules/dialog/types.ts; symbol: DialogContentProps; revision: sha256:8e23f4e3ef996d12c6c13b991fb0727676d9a7fe0119452f5fc0f127522d0ec8 | None |
| detail / content-detail | Short visible factual detail shown beside a content unit's context label, such as reading time or publication date; never an accessible description and never a control prop. | Use: A content unit's context row shows one short consumer-formatted fact beside its context label.<br>Avoid: Accessible descriptions, selectable-option metadata, controls, or component-computed reading times and dates. | approved; Reference: docs/components/article-feature/v0.1/prop-naming-approval.json; scope: convention:content-detail; contentHash: sha256:776d267bd7a5e3630987ac0518b15ea3677394d0c6a1b15cf9e4664ea44a9ea7 | ArticleFeature: string (existing); path: packages/ui/src/molecules/article-feature/types.ts; symbol: ArticleFeatureProps; revision: sha256:7adcf6ea1db188214aaa20f1e8c9a8706ac7a7d206d5d306ac4b5bf8d71294ac | None |

| dragRotate / interaction-drag-rotate | Whether the user may drag a decorative effect to rotate it away from its scene pose before it springs back. | Use: A decorative effect exposes opt-in direct-manipulation rotation; clamping, capture and release behavior are component-specific.<br>Avoid: Ambient pointer tilt (use pointer-tilt), selection or camera-control APIs, or gestures that trap touch scroll outside an explicitly interactive posture. | approved; Reference: docs/decisions/prop-naming-isotipo3d-interaction-approval.json; scope: convention:interaction-drag-rotate; contentHash: sha256:270ead1bac9c0fda9dd3aec967587ca03286e28b6a1405a669c88705e36623a7 | Isotipo3D: boolean (drag-to-rotate offsets, default false) (existing); path: packages/effects/src/atoms/isotipo3d/types.ts; symbol: Isotipo3DProps; revision: sha256:0099ebba8fc63ca6fd3a3817b74ec2f311bd387f9ce521efa1391f5791144164 | None |
| dropLabel / drop-target-label | Visible text a drop target shows while compatible items are dragged over it. | Use: A drop target replaces its resting text during drag-over, such as Drop here.<br>Avoid: The resting accessible name, error messages or generic hover text. | approved; Reference: docs/decisions/prop-naming-atom-specs-approval.json; scope: convention:drop-target-label; contentHash: sha256:684ecfcd55900b34f3ae9671a691246768c97913442d62ee35dabd0c8e52da9e | Dropzone: string (existing); path: packages/ui/src/atoms/dropzone/types.ts; symbol: DropzoneProps; revision: sha256:039ddd0b4c3147bdb44aece52cc9e21e0ed57f5cb42991b787f8fe494206cef8 | None |
| duration / auto-dismiss-duration | Time in milliseconds a transient component stays visible before dismissing itself; Infinity disables auto-dismissal. | Use: A notification or similar transient element closes automatically after a consumer-adjustable time.<br>Avoid: Animation or transition durations, countdown targets, polling intervals or media lengths. | approved; Reference: docs/decisions/prop-naming-molecule-specs-approval.json; scope: convention:auto-dismiss-duration; contentHash: sha256:b3ca83682e8ce6d4eb40289923c084ded07cf40f7d2df483b1287a48ec4a3d9f | Toast: number (Infinity disables auto-dismissal; 0 falls back through Radix) (existing); path: packages/ui/src/molecules/toast/types.ts; symbol: ToastProps; revision: sha256:8a75318c1beba842284bd1c27f46fb5a152431ab604f2f1d02a8cac6bbc2adb8 | None |

| fill / host-fill | Opt in to filling a definite-height host's block size, with fixed chrome and an internal native scrolling region; absence keeps content-sized height. | Use: A component sits in a host that owns a definite height and should keep its header, footer or tab list fixed while one inner region scrolls natively.<br>Avoid: Inline-axis width (fullWidth), positioning (sticky), height caps (maxHeight), arrangement (layout) or solid glyph rendering (filled). | approved; Reference: docs/decisions/prop-naming-panel-tabs-fill-approval.json; scope: convention:host-fill; contentHash: sha256:b223d062d6fe022e97b092a24f8902c787d82eb6d44d14281b92fff22c4ab395 | Panel: boolean (optional) (existing); path: packages/ui/src/molecules/panel/types.ts; symbol: PanelProps; revision: sha256:c997a450746974b751573a482de9d4e012e35f042018d2367381f878bce9ae00<br>Tabs: boolean (optional) (existing); path: packages/ui/src/molecules/tabs/types.ts; symbol: TabsProps; revision: sha256:c05bfef92a84c0acb95527dbd074256d1d267c76ccd1dd8b55d263544157bbe2 | None |

| filtering / collection-filtering | Whether a searchable collection filters its consumer-supplied entries with its built-in matcher or renders them unchanged because the consumer already filtered them. | Use: A component offers built-in client-side matching but must also support server-side or custom search results.<br>Avoid: Choosing the matching algorithm or ranking, sorting, pagination, or hiding disabled entries. | approved; Reference: docs/decisions/prop-naming-organism-specs-approval.json; scope: convention:collection-filtering; contentHash: sha256:f86b73a3d5bc39e134d521e99c345b47e5e4eda40afab45b99e95cde2c72908d | CommandPalette: CommandPaletteFiltering (default builtin) (existing); path: packages/ui/src/molecules/command-palette/types.ts; symbol: CommandPaletteProps; revision: sha256:b31b27cb49732de296d732686d0f18224608b326542d117481d53ff48a3f747f | None |

| icon / leading-icon | Optional decorative icon rendered beside a component's text label (before it by default) and hidden from assistive technology. Button alone may place this icon before or after its label, after it by default. Toggle alone also accepts a required decorative icon as its sole visible content, with a required accessible label. IconButton alone requires one decorative ReactElement icon, named separately by its required label. | Use: A labelled component offers a leading pictogram that repeats or decorates meaning already present in its text. Button alone also permits its iconPosition start/end slot, default end. Toggle alone permits its icon-only branch when icon and accessible label are both required. IconButton alone also permits required decorative icon-only content with a separate required label.<br>Avoid: Icon-only controls (their accessible name is a separate required prop), trailing or interactive icons, or the sole carrier of meaning. Three scoped exceptions apply: Button with iconPosition may place the icon after its label; Toggle with a required icon and accessible label may render icon-only; IconButton.icon with its required label is icon-only by design. No other component gains trailing-icon or icon-only permission, and interactive icons remain excluded. | approved; Reference: docs/components/icon-button/v0.1/prop-naming-approval-leading-icon-combined.json; | modal / interaction-modality | Whether an open floating dialog restricts focus, assistive-technology access and pointer interaction to its own content instead of allowing interaction with the surrounding page. | Use: A floating dialog supports both non-modal and modal interaction through its underlying Radix primitive; the component defines dismissal and focus restoration separately.<br>Avoid: A visual scrim, a guarantee that a workflow cannot be dismissed, overlay elevation, or custom implementations of focus trapping and outside-interaction blocking. | approved; Reference: docs/decisions/prop-naming-molecule-specs-approval.json; scope: convention:interaction-modality; contentHash: sha256:a1b17de345877cfc32c4b0ec4ff757373f2beff70bcc1add9358ac04920150d1 | Popover: boolean (existing); path: packages/ui/src/molecules/popover/types.ts; symbol: PopoverProps; revision: sha256:b6397ad1b70dd859c32d4132f31bc302032ee7e2ace15338219817dca43d6bde | None |

| name / icon-glyph-name | Identifier of the glyph that the Icon component draws from the closed system icon set. | Use: Select which system glyph Icon renders.<br>Avoid: Icon slots inside other components (use leading-icon/icon), native form-control name attributes or arbitrary SVG content. | approved; Reference: docs/decisions/prop-naming-atom-specs-approval.json; scope: convention:icon-glyph-name; contentHash: sha256:ef9238a6d55457a7d986f47ba75fd0d0cf85b1103ab94acda4ee451e7da9820b | Icon: IconName (closed 48-name glyph set) (existing); path: packages/ui/src/atoms/icon/types.ts; symbol: IconProps; revision: sha256:81b4efe2a2f4ec337bac642fad1bb25f6bfe1fa3e04bd12a58c0dd24e276ab97 | None |

| onAdd / add-request | Notification that the user activated a component's built-in add control; the consumer performs the creation flow. | onExpire / deadline-expiration | Notification that the client observed a countdown deadline reached, receiving the expired instant in Unix epoch milliseconds. | Use: A countdown reports expiration with an explicit component-specific episode and remount policy so consumers can react or announce separately.<br>Avoid: Per-second ticks, user-driven value changes, callbacks during render or SSR, authoritative event-start signals or cross-instance exactly-once guarantees. | approved; Reference: docs/decisions/prop-naming-molecule-specs-approval.json; scope: convention:deadline-expiration; contentHash: sha256:4cfd772a5cf1576b23a3c8c92bc48c80c786bb097fc3ca31c9054cf8e143f117 | Countdown: (deadline: number) =&gt; void (existing); path: packages/ui/src/atoms/countdown/types.ts; symbol: CountdownProps; revision: sha256:35d8c209c7aa249f4a78bb3c0c8c1154dd34affed22529cff4af8e134b97908e | None |
| onFiles / files-received | Notification carrying the files the user picked, dropped or pasted into a file target. | Use: A component accepts files from the user and hands them to the consumer for validation and upload.<br>Avoid: Upload progress or results, value changes of non-file inputs, or validation feedback. | approved; Reference: docs/decisions/prop-naming-atom-specs-approval.json; scope: convention:files-received; contentHash: sha256:5f5b718ed824a2773263a057d33d19922de5e04611b420f315c90f2a8a2fc5e9 | Dropzone: (files: File[]) =&gt; void (existing); path: packages/ui/src/atoms/dropzone/types.ts; symbol: DropzoneProps; revision: sha256:039ddd0b4c3147bdb44aece52cc9e21e0ed57f5cb42991b787f8fe494206cef8 | None |

| padding / inner-padding | Preset inner spacing between a container's edge and its content, mapped to spacing tokens. | Use: A container primitive such as Surface offers a few token-backed padding presets, including none for edge-to-edge content.<br>Avoid: Gaps between children (use gap), outer margins, arbitrary lengths or per-side overrides. | approved; Reference: docs/components/dialog/v0.2/prop-naming-approval.json; scope: convention:inner-padding; contentHash: sha256:ed9f2dbc2dcfde6cc74120161628a7d30bfd0870509dc30775ef5675225641b6 | CollapsibleContent: 'sm' &#124; 'md' (default md) (existing); path: packages/ui/src/molecules/collapsible/types.ts; symbol: CollapsibleContentProps; revision: sha256:61da0f12cd4be4e75fb99deff1db3d5170479542b951ed3d744e2304d211ae46<br>DialogContent: 'default' &#124; 'compact' (body only; default default) (existing); path: packages/ui/src/molecules/dialog/types.ts; symbol: DialogContentProps; revision: sha256:8e23f4e3ef996d12c6c13b991fb0727676d9a7fe0119452f5fc0f127522d0ec8<br>Surface: SurfacePadding (none&#124;sm&#124;md&#124;lg) (existing); path: packages/ui/src/primitives/surface/types.ts; symbol: SurfaceProps; revision: sha256:26d0726b5034dceb74e0067c1c0df5108d351e948205bbf22b5e187b92d9c0b6 | Approved exception (DialogContent → bodyPadding): Only the body changes; padding would misleadingly describe the whole panel; Reference: docs/components/dialog/v0.2/prop-naming-approval.json; scope: exception:inner-padding:DialogContent:bodyPadding; contentHash: sha256:46747e9c21ddd6a44b9c29cfb04f3f388b60d790b6724ef05874dc69bf17fffa |
| paused / paused-presentation | Shows the represented entity as paused or inactive with visual de-emphasis and data-state="paused". | Use: A channel, account or similar entity is paused and the meaning is also given in text.<br>Avoid: Disabled controls (use native disabled), loading, or as the only cue for the paused meaning. | approved; Reference: docs/decisions/prop-naming-atom-specs-approval.json; scope: convention:paused-presentation; contentHash: sha256:219caeeb57708a58d487b04dc56c148f300734c22fb283f3639ead2f94b93ce1 | Avatar: boolean (existing); path: packages/ui/src/atoms/avatar/types.ts; symbol: AvatarProps; revision: sha256:257f17ea206a79e5a560cc7593f2f5c456bdca5dda51bc9c11fdb5ce418f1817 | None |
| pending / modal-action-pending | A consumer-declared action is in flight for a modal, temporarily locking its owned dismissal controls. | Use: Declare an in-flight action on a modal root while the consumer owns completion, progress and recovery.<br>Avoid: Automatic Promise tracking, arbitrary child controls, per-control loading, collection refresh or progress values. | approved; Reference: docs/components/alert-dialog/v0.2/prop-naming-approval.json; scope: convention:modal-action-pending; contentHash: sha256:30e77a03fd259a757c236e831ad06fc7ff71b4a60c2a4bcf77fb055b1d251489 | AlertDialog: boolean (optional; default false) (existing); path: packages/ui/src/molecules/alert-dialog/types.ts; symbol: AlertDialogProps; revision: sha256:5f4908ab3c919e382f244ec2b22759376d2cd6ebb842010e8d2e9c7da3fb1c8b | None |
| placeholder / selection-placeholder | Hint text shown in a choice control while no value is selected; not the accessible name or a default value. | Use: A non-native choice control (such as a Radix Select trigger) needs the equivalent of a native input placeholder.<br>Avoid: Native inputs and textareas, which already have the placeholder attribute; using it as a label, instruction that must stay visible, or selected value. | approved; Reference: docs/decisions/prop-naming-atom-specs-approval.json; scope: convention:selection-placeholder; contentHash: sha256:2db3a4a84161a87011054006709ce352ac2d86bb4c240b68033f8ecb7f47fa05 | Select: string (hint only while unselected; not an accessible name) (existing); path: packages/ui/src/atoms/select/types.ts; symbol: SelectProps; revision: sha256:871e3ee90b814ee284e748ea3c8b48133afdfc87397d425cdfbc279eb3e52838 | None |
| pointerTilt / pointer-tilt | Whether a decorative effect may apply a bounded pointer-relative tilt when its motion and input policy permits it. | Use: Let a consumer disable decorative pointer tilt; eligible pointer types, scenes, bounds and reduced-motion behavior are component-specific.<br>Avoid: Drag or selection interactions, keyboard behavior, arbitrary transforms, general animation toggles or bypassing reduced motion. | approved; Reference: docs/decisions/prop-naming-isotipo3d-approval.json; scope: convention:pointer-tilt; contentHash: sha256:4dd09b904cc3152e23929278dda86055a623f6c837977a691d7f7f93d71e5c00 | Isotipo3D: boolean (existing); path: packages/effects/src/atoms/isotipo3d/types.ts; symbol: Isotipo3DProps; revision: sha256:0099ebba8fc63ca6fd3a3817b74ec2f311bd387f9ce521efa1391f5791144164 | None |
| position / anchor-corner-position | Physical corner of a non-floating anchor where a passive supplementary marker is placed. | Use: A passive anchored marker selects top-left, top-right, bottom-left or bottom-right without automatic RTL mirroring; Indicator uses IndicatorPosition with default top-right.<br>Avoid: Floating content side or collision handling (use floating-side/side), logical start/end placement, automatic RTL flipping, icon placement beside a label, or positioning an interactive overlay. | approved; Reference: docs/components/remaining-components/v0.1/ui-first-wave-owner-approvals.md; scope: convention:anchor-corner-position; contentHash: sha256:26f3ae6a441f8bf0776bd794896e38d2ec3ce7b207dd7fe2e577c0c140a5e13f | Indicator: IndicatorPosition ('top-left' &#124; 'top-right' &#124; 'bottom-left' &#124; 'bottom-right') (existing); path: packages/ui/src/atoms/indicator/types.ts; symbol: IndicatorProps; revision: sha256:118721454e5b6f37753f295171b4d74c3a6774e280fca8c75278cf99e219fb69 | None |

| pressed / pressed-state | Controlled on/off pressed state of a toggle control, exposed as aria-pressed. | Use: A single control persists an on/off state the user switches by pressing it.<br>Avoid: Selection of a value from a set (use value), form checkbox semantics (checked) or transient active styling. | approved; Reference: docs/decisions/prop-naming-atom-specs-approval.json; scope: convention:pressed-state; contentHash: sha256:758992ccf2fc84669d8d696cd6bea56d0de490fb8d772f179ada72679a670654 | Chip: boolean (existing); path: packages/ui/src/atoms/chip/types.ts; symbol: ChipProps; revision: sha256:8cdf8fe542702525be06a0b40c2f49b0ffc2b3f5f7f6161f829025b80690f4c8<br>Toggle: boolean (existing); path: packages/ui/src/atoms/toggle/types.ts; symbol: ToggleProps; revision: sha256:6d0eec4fa75b1a67f055c67133945f948ab134db3a33589255414dfb6c006a1a | None |
| product / product-identity | Identity of a product or application presented by a structural region: a consumer-supplied node, its visible and accessible name, and an optional home destination. | Use: An application region such as a sidebar presents a product using consumer-supplied artwork such as Logo, Avatar or another node, its name and optionally its home destination.<br>Avoid: Page or section headings (use title), accessible names of controls (use label), or assuming a specific artwork component. | approved; Reference: docs/components/sidebar/v0.1/product-identity-approval.json; scope: convention:product-identity; contentHash: sha256:8f5fdb1212b182c2e469051481597a21a26b913e021257ad4d760f169f6f4f1b | ModuleRail: ProductIdentity (consumer node, name, optional href) (existing); path: packages/ui/src/organisms/module-rail/types.ts; symbol: ModuleRailProps; revision: sha256:a21f7c5ee39eb148b115ea95a82bd820c692ba3a4f855af380ffc20f3b4f95bd<br>Sidebar: ProductIdentity (consumer node, name, optional href) (existing); path: packages/ui/src/organisms/sidebar/types.ts; symbol: SidebarProps; revision: sha256:80a3f250f00ba2e2b6cd250e2892d05412ceed441c9f4111fbc4a3959042dbf0 | None |
| profile / effect-profile | A named preset of engine parameters for a decorative effect layer. | Use: Select among the effect presets supported by the component, such as density and speed profiles.<br>Avoid: Do not use it for visual Material treatment, sizes or arbitrary per-parameter overrides; preset names and values are component-specific. | approved; Reference: docs/decisions/prop-naming-ambient-background-approval.json; scope: convention:effect-profile; contentHash: sha256:293194eade9734f78ff66b5f2174df11e8984d0dc312fa5d0d6eb924c3d694b6 | AmbientBackground: AmbientBackgroundProfile ('base' &#124; 'read' &#124; 'live') (existing); path: packages/effects/src/ambient-background/types.ts; symbol: AmbientBackgroundProps; revision: sha256:59eaea0ac13b3b8236ebdf90ae8a839b8c416326937a743272acc517d89bcba1 | None |
| progress / effect-progress | Consumer-supplied normalized local progress used to evaluate a decorative effect scene. | Use: Drive a decorative pose or assembly curve independently of how the consumer derives its progress; normalization is component-specific.<br>Avoid: Task-completion or measurement semantics, accessible progress indicators, internal elapsed time or an uncontrolled user selection. | approved; Reference: docs/decisions/prop-naming-isotipo3d-approval.json; scope: convention:effect-progress; contentHash: sha256:5d3b9c8baefc158b078147f53b76a57f54a63e825c105f63f638010c2188a4b9 | Isotipo3D: number (existing); path: packages/effects/src/atoms/isotipo3d/types.ts; symbol: Isotipo3DProps; revision: sha256:0099ebba8fc63ca6fd3a3817b74ec2f311bd387f9ce521efa1391f5791144164 | None |

| radius / corner-radius | Preset corner radius of a container, mapped to radius tokens. | Use: A container primitive offers token-backed corner presets, such as none for bands inside a panel or full for pills.<br>Avoid: Arbitrary lengths, per-corner overrides or shape changes that alter the component's meaning. | approved; Reference: docs/decisions/prop-naming-molecule-specs-approval.json; scope: convention:corner-radius; contentHash: sha256:e09a3c41f5a7808c4e82d9dfc926f5c0747c227cbb67b43f53acdfa99c679f08 | Surface: SurfaceRadius (none&#124;md&#124;lg&#124;xl&#124;full) (existing); path: packages/ui/src/primitives/surface/types.ts; symbol: SurfaceProps; revision: sha256:26d0726b5034dceb74e0067c1c0df5108d351e948205bbf22b5e187b92d9c0b6 | None |
| ratio / aspect-ratio | The width-to-height proportion of a reserved media or content region, independent of its rendered dimensions. | Use: A primitive or media component reserves proportional space; the component-specific type may be a numeric width divided by height or a documented set of format presets.<br>Avoid: Absolute width or height, image crop or object-fit policy, measurement values, or Material treatment. | approved; Reference: docs/decisions/prop-naming-molecule-specs-approval.json; scope: convention:aspect-ratio; contentHash: sha256:bbef626ac769aef5d57f18e67b323715be50d20e75f467c5fca95879c183b0ff | AspectRatio: number (existing); path: packages/ui/src/primitives/aspect-ratio/types.ts; symbol: AspectRatioProps; revision: sha256:771b93daa9a3c3548cba5ea6172b0182b32705e6ab7caeaf1b207641669ff1ed<br>PhotoFrame: PhotoFrameRatio ('square' &#124; 'portrait' &#124; 'landscape' &#124; 'auto') &#124; number (numeric width divided by height; unrepresentable numbers fall back to a square) (existing); path: packages/ui/src/atoms/photo-frame/types.ts; symbol: PhotoFrameProps; revision: sha256:fad6ce9bb92ea38a215c7c0f105bc1ba18c4a5e14144724a09bb984981b017b6<br>PreviewFrame: number (width divided by height; invalid values fall back to 16:9) (existing); path: packages/ui/src/organisms/preview-frame/types.ts; symbol: PreviewFrameProps; revision: sha256:e61cc416f86355b6d60841a969c93d5e027be1571be8f7f23347ce96e70530c4<br>SelectTile: SelectTileRatio = 'landscape' &#124; 'portrait' &#124; 'story' &#124; 'square' &#124; 'wide' &#124; 'banner' (existing); path: packages/ui/src/molecules/select-tile/types.ts; symbol: SelectTileProps; revision: sha256:09b965558a8a8bc2e8cb2373ed9bbb9980d2494f1234731b48737b6cd1dac9c8 | None |
| readout / value-readout | Visible text of a control's current value shown next to its label in an output element linked to the control. | Use: A control whose value is not readable on the control itself, such as a slider, shows its formatted value.<br>Avoid: Accessible value text (use the control's own value text), counters, hints or editable values. | approved; Reference: docs/decisions/prop-naming-molecule-specs-approval.json; scope: convention:value-readout; contentHash: sha256:542a4f8e79a608cedb5e1e403f8ddfa2728092293856e497141cd9cc7189fbc6 | Field: string (existing); path: packages/ui/src/molecules/field/types.ts; symbol: FieldProps; revision: sha256:c997f2c6ebad779ae8be50769c94a75df2981f4f830d6fc5ef17e71ee0fcb1a1 | None |

| resetKey / transient-feedback-reset-key | Consumer token changes reset component-defined transient feedback without changing its value or remounting. | Use: Use declaratively when a consumer needs to reset transient feedback.<br>Avoid: List resets, React identity keys and callbacks. | approved; Reference: docs/decisions/prop-naming-attachment-field-reset-key-approval.json; scope: convention:transient-feedback-reset-key; contentHash: sha256:8e01ec065900955aad6ed92e470fe2dd4f4a33a38112b184e92f65360ecb8b82 | AttachmentField: string &#124; number (optional) (existing); path: packages/ui/src/molecules/attachment-field/types.ts; symbol: AttachmentFieldProps; revision: sha256:8eec15ec1b4e1c079e35cf988d49a494fb6d52818bad5ea94a03970f1ed4bcf9 | None |

| safeArea / safe-area-guide | Whether a fixed-ratio preview canvas shows a decorative inset rectangle marking the area safe from edge cropping on output devices. | Use: A preview of broadcast, video or social output shows where essential content must stay.<br>Avoid: Device safe-area insets (env(safe-area-inset-*)) for page layout, padding presets (use padding), or interactive crop handles. | approved; Reference: docs/decisions/prop-naming-organism-specs-approval.json; scope: convention:safe-area-guide; contentHash: sha256:6907abfdc393028cba8972e992275e8428c7837715d2e7deb190b3e35dcb5ccf | PreviewFrame: boolean (default true) (existing); path: packages/ui/src/organisms/preview-frame/types.ts; symbol: PreviewFrameProps; revision: sha256:e61cc416f86355b6d60841a969c93d5e027be1571be8f7f23347ce96e70530c4 | None |
| scene / effect-scene | A named pose family of a decorative effect, optionally evaluated at consumer-supplied local progress. | Use: Select a decorative effect's supported camera, assembly or explosion scene; scene names are component-specific.<br>Avoid: Engine parameter presets (use effect-profile), Material treatments, page choreography, task progress or lifecycle state. | approved; Reference: docs/decisions/prop-naming-isotipo3d-approval.json; scope: convention:effect-scene; contentHash: sha256:a0ddc8aa8c8209ef712164e164408cf2e0d49d7b1ff11a9497d7e40c78f37818 | Isotipo3D: 'hero' &#124; 'chapter' &#124; 'lab' &#124; 'outro' (existing); path: packages/effects/src/atoms/isotipo3d/types.ts; symbol: Isotipo3DProps; revision: sha256:0099ebba8fc63ca6fd3a3817b74ec2f311bd387f9ce521efa1391f5791144164 | None |
